A metal sphere cools from 80 \(^\circ\)C to 60 \(^\circ\)C in 6 min. How much time with it take to cool from 60 \(^\circ\)C to 40 \(^\circ\)C if the room temperature is 30 \(^\circ\)C?
_note: The printed stem writes 'How much time with it take' for 'will it take'; transcribed verbatim. The printed answer of 10 min is METHOD-DEPENDENT - see the ingestion report; evaluating Newton's law at each interval's INITIAL temperature gives exactly 10 min, while the mean-temperature method gives 12 min and exact integration 12.9 min.
